notes.title: Update Notes Version R109
notes.notes:
Changes for versions from R104 to R109:
[list]
[*]Mods can have adjusted settings for career start year, career start team and points structure. Check guide for details: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2995950923
[*]New events in career mode for when a team has a commanding lead in development
[*]Hungary and Brazil AI improved lines
[*]Canada AI handles wet weather better and crashes less
[*]Improved AI pit strategies for rain
[*]Increased difficulty for Legend
[*]Removed default radio beep with modded audio
[*]Balance tweaks
[*]Bug fixes (including fix for crash with new team Armando)
[/list]

notes.title: Release weekend!
notes.notes:
Formula TOP release weekend is here! A preview of the new features and the new track is live right now and Career mode is unlocked on Sunday to celebrate the 1.0 launch. A list of all changes will be posted on release day.

Multiplayer races daily on the EU server!

Leaderboards have been reset, Early Access times will be preserved on the Discord server.

notes.title: New track and progress update
notes.notes:
There's a new track: Great Britain! I'm working on the big 1.0 update but it's still some months of work to get everything I want in so I thought I'd share a bit of something in the meanwhile.

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/sDhrVzXuNp]Discord server[/url] for a small preview of the upcoming car setup feature.

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Autumn update for the Playtest
notes.notes:
Autumn update for the Playtest is live! Try out the new tracks in practice mode and join the Discord server to see when multiplayer races are on. The full version with AI, career mode, pit stops and more will be released Q1/23.

The most important part of the autumn update is raising the track count from 1 to 4! Ruska Racing Center features three unique tracks in one area: one traditional layout and two very different takes on high speed racing. Rest of the full game's track lineup will consist of realistic tracks.

Some other key elements in the update:
-dynamic camera zoom
-smoother car turning
-lap times are sent to leaderboards (viewing possible later)

You can request access to the Playtest on the store page, access will be granted immediately.
